full_prompt_en: A square digital mixed-media portrait shows a woman's face emerging from the right side of a cloud of angular fragments on a pale ivory background. The visible face occupies the center-right, with one strongly shaded eye, a slim nose, and softly closed lips modeled in near-monochrome photographic tones. Much of the left side of the head is replaced by overlapping pieces of brown, charcoal, rust red, and faded gold. Some fragments resemble torn paper or dried leaves, while others are sharp triangular planes; together they form a broken crown that extends toward the upper-left corner. A rust-colored triangle points right near the face, and finer scratches and thin construction lines radiate through the open cream field. At the lower center, the portrait breaks into scattered dustlike marks rather than a clear neck or shoulder. Tiny printed-looking flecks and incomplete marks appear among the fragments, but none forms legible text. The image balances high-resolution softness in the skin with rough, semi-transparent collage texture at the dissolving edge. Light appears to come from the upper left, brightening the forehead and cheek while leaving the eye socket and underside of the nose in cool gray shade. The background remains almost empty around the right and lower edges, giving the busy upper-left cluster room to spread. Its geometry is not a conventional frame; faint arcs and alignment lines hint at a constructed layout without enclosing the face. The overall composition is intimate and fractured, with a calm expression held inside a storm of paperlike color and sharp graphic interruptions.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字混合媒介肖像描绘一张女子面孔从浅象牙色背景上的棱角碎片云中浮出。可见的脸位于中央偏右，一只浓阴影眼、细鼻和轻闭嘴唇以近单色摄影影调塑形。头部左侧很大部分被棕、炭灰、锈红和褪金的重叠碎片替代。有些碎片像撕纸或枯叶，另一些是尖锐三角面；它们共同形成破碎头冠，延向左上角。一枚锈色三角形在脸旁指向右，细划痕与纤细构图线穿过敞开的奶油色画域。下方中央，肖像碎成尘埃般散点，没有清楚的脖子或肩。碎片中有细小印刷般斑点和不完整记号，却没有可读文字。图像以皮肤的高分辨柔和质感平衡消散边缘的粗糙半透明拼贴肌理。光似乎从左上进入，照亮额头和脸颊，让眼窝和鼻下留在冷灰阴影。右侧与下缘周围背景几乎空白，使繁忙左上聚团有伸展空间。几何形不是普通边框；淡弧和对齐线暗示构造过的版式，却没有把脸圈住。整体构图亲密而破碎，平静神情被纸般颜色和锐利图形打断包在其中。
style_prompt_en: The image has a refined digital collage finish that sets softly modeled monochrome volumes against fractured, semi-transparent material. Cream negative space surrounds an asymmetric cluster of rust, umber, charcoal, and muted gold. Sharp triangles, rubbed paper edges, tiny specks, and fine diagramlike lines disperse from a denser focal zone into open ground. Light grazes the smooth central planes, while fragmented overlays carry more granular texture and irregular opacity. Crisp graphic cuts coexist with dissolving dustlike edges, producing movement without an overt scene. The overall effect is elegant, cerebral, and gently unstable.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现精细数字拼贴完成面，柔和塑形的单色体积对照破碎半透明材料。奶油色留白围住不对称的锈红、棕褐、炭灰和低饱和金色聚团。尖三角、磨擦纸边、微点和细示意图般线条从密集焦点区散向空地。光擦亮中央平滑平面，碎片叠层则承载更多颗粒和不规则透明度。清楚图形切口与尘埃般溶散边缘共存，不依赖明确场景也产生运动。整体效果优雅、理性且轻微不稳定。
theme_en: A woman's face dissolving into angular fragments on a pale graphic field
theme_zh: 女子面孔在浅色图形画域中消散为棱角碎片
name: Bojan Jevtic
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
